# teltonika_rms_companies (Data Source)

Lists every company visible to the token (`GET /companies`, paginated transparently).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "teltonika_rms_companies" "all" {}

output "company_names" {
  value = [for c in data.teltonika_rms_companies.all.companies : c.name]
}
```
